title: The Missing Backpack
summary: Mia's blue backpack disappeared from the café yesterday afternoon. You watched it for her for a while. Tell her what you saw and ask the right questions to find out what happened.
npc_opening: Oh, thank goodness you're here! My backpack is gone. My keys and my notebook were in it. You were here yesterday, right? What did you see?

objectives.description: Tell Mia what you did and saw at the café yesterday.
Ask Mia when and where she last had the backpack.
Suggest what Mia could do to get the backpack back.
